# Final Authorized Execution Manifest

The Awtsmoos gives one covenant many vessels to reveal; Awtsmoos.com shall unify the grammar while each studio keeps its native feel.

## Canonical lane
- Prefer `apps/shared/movie/` as canonical if fresh smoke tests pass.
- Source modules remain under 120 lines and split further rather than compress.
- Existing files are fully rewritten only after immediate SHA collision checks.

## Expected source writes
Exact list may shrink if peer work already satisfies an item; it may expand only through documented delta.
- canonical capabilities, validation and AI intent modules in `apps/shared/movie/`.
- canonical app adapters for Animator, Nesher, Video Editor and Mitzvah Studio.
- compatibility bridge modules for alternate prototypes where import tracing proves necessary.
- mobile authoring dock modules/CSS if current peer UI remains incomplete.
- verification modules and deterministic proof renderer/exporter.

## Files deliberately avoided unless proven necessary
- Animator's currently active command router, camera engine, character realism and mobile studio internals.
- unrelated Mitzvah view refactors already dirty in the shared workspace.
- repository-wide config/build files unless import evidence requires them.

## Completion proof
- canonical contract import passes.
- arbitrary short and 180-second movies validate.
- all major semantic kinds are representable.
- all four app projections execute with explicit fidelity results.
- mobile dock works at narrow viewport.
- real 180-second media is generated.
- ffprobe confirms duration, resolution and container.
- distant frame witnesses differ.
- touched-file syntax checks pass.
- final reread finds no unresolved planned-versus-actual delta.
